trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release that was running in every region.
- **Current state:** All three regions are on v2.3.0, which reports healthy with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback, and the post-rollback status. Its next steps are to confirm sustained recovery and investigate v2.3.1 before any redeploy.

The first attempt to open the incident was rate-limited. The retry used the same idempotency key, so only one incident was created.
